title: The Autonomous Revolution: Artificial Intelligence and the Future of the Automotive Industry
description: AI is reshaping the automotive industry through autonomous driving, predictive maintenance, smart manufacturing, mobility services, and liability headaches.
short_description: A grounded look at autonomous vehicles, predictive maintenance, smart manufacturing, and the liability questions parked behind the showroom shine.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in the automotive industry for operators, planners, analysts, product teams, and readers tracking mobility systems.
